request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a steam paddle boat: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim; the red sail, mast and pennant become one tall copper #d06a2a smokestack puffing white steam; add a copper paddle wheel on the side and a small bright green #2bd94a lamp. Nothing red. Keep the boat shape, size, waterline, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
